source_refs.note: 3. No Intermolecular Forces: a main subheading of 6.1 Assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 119-119.

blocks.text: Gas ke molecules ek doosre ko na kheenchte hain (attraction) na dhakelte hain (repulsion). Takrane ke waqt ke siwa woh ek doosre par koi force nahi lagate.
